entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • .NET 11 RC1 - SQL Server: `IsUnique()` on an index over a JSON-mapped member is silently dropped #39065
  • .NET 11 RC1 - SQLite: index on a member of a JSON-mapped complex type indexes the whole column #39064
  • Unified interceptor registration #39063
  • Precompiled query generation emits expression variable names verbatim, producing invalid C# for names that are not identifiers #39061
  • Owned JSON collection navigation absent from the stored document materializes as null (owned counterpart of #38625) #39060
  • Negated nullable comparison in a conditional returns wrong results #39059

PullRequests

Created

  • Specify an explicit token for the judge model used in eval #39067
    area-harness
  • [release/11.0] Rollback Microsoft.Build.Framework to 18.9.6 #39066
    area-infrastructure
  • Sanitize expression variable names when generating precompiled query code #39062
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39057

Merged

  • Use the invariant culture when parsing JSON TimeOnly values #39069
    community-contribution
  • Parse scaffolded date and time default literals with the invariant culture in scaffolding #38959
    community-contribution
  • Throw for invalid string values of unsigned enums in JSON #39068
    community-contribution
  • Ensure DateOnly, DateTime, and DateTimeOffset string conversions use CultureInfo.InvariantCulture during formatting to avoid non-Gregorian culture pitfalls. #38715
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • Switch eval workflow to use an explicit PAT #39053
    area-harness
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39058
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39055

Updated

  • Materialize required collections absent from a JSON document as empty #39014
    community-contribution
  • Turn on Helix Job Monitor #38751
  • Escape Unicode line separators in CSharpHelper string and char literals #38711
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0' => 'release/9.0' #39056
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #39054
